sources.title: Reznik–Garcia–Stachel, Area-Invariant Pedal-Like Curves Derived from the Ellipse, arXiv2009.02581v3,16Sep2020
checked_locations: Complete definitions/main theorem statements; §§2–4 proofs and area formulas; appendix statements
sources.verified_coverage: Steiner/Sturm moving-pedal-point radial area property; continuous ellipse pedal/contrapedal/related curve area formulas.
sources.target_gap_or_status: Changing point for one fixed polygon/continuous full-curve integral does not yield phase product for a finite evolving billiard polygon. The total auxiliary-circle area πa² is not the N-chord polygon area.

sources.title: Hsu–Chou–Liu–Liang–Chang, Topics on Pedal Polygons, arXiv2108.08293v1,14Aug2021
checked_locations: Complete seven-page text, especially Definitions2.1–2.2, Theorem2.8 and §3
sources.verified_coverage: Rotating-angle outer/inner polygon area sum and iterated pedal equivalence.
sources.target_gap_or_status: Its word outer denotes a different angle-constrained construction; no confocal billiard or two fixed focal area-product theorem. Pedal equivalence alone supplies no phase-independent scale.

sources.title: Ferudun, Outer-Pedal Area Products in Elliptic Billiards, version1.1,1Oct2026,DOI10.5281/zenodo.23088516
checked_locations: Complete theorem/proof §§1–6, point-dependence §7 and limitations §8; nine-page PDF
sources.verified_coverage: Theorem1 Aouter*B_M for leastN≡2 mod4 arbitraryM; Theorem2 oddN included only for M=O. Lemma4 proves parallel-residue cancellation for general outer pedal map under its period hypotheses.
sources.target_gap_or_status: Not literal odd focal product. Odd-center invariant leaves the odd linear pedal-point term unsupported. Closely overlapping area pole method and outer-foot residue lemma require current-work credit; extending Lemma4 to focal oddN is extra checkable application.

sources.title: Ferudun, Focal Pedal-Antipedal Area Products in Elliptic Billiards,1Oct2026,DOI10.5281/zenodo.23079799

sources.target_gap_or_status: No oddN coverage and different factors. Padding odd orbit to4n does not supply the quarter-period permutation; explicitly blocked by paper itself.
